controls.title: ICT risk management

controls.summary: A documented framework of strategies, policies, procedures and tools to protect ICT assets.

controls.title: ICT systems, protocols and tools

controls.summary: Identify and classify ICT-supported business functions, assets and dependencies.

controls.title: Learning and evolving
